entities.summary: The Turkmen Agricultural University named after Saparmurat Niyazov, often abbreviated as TOHU, is the largest higher education institution in Turkmenistan. This university only provides studies in the fields of agriculture. It is named after Saparmyrat Nyýazow, Turkmenistan's first president.
